export_evidence: ImportKey, India customs records for ARISTO PHARMACEUTICALS PRIVATE LIMITED (Plot No. 76, 77, 207, 208 and 209, Mandideep, Raisen): "2026-02-27 | ARISTO PHARMACEUTICALS PRIVATE LIMITED | VIV PHARMA (PRIVATE) LIMITED | HARMLESS MEDICINES : Fexofen-120 [Fexofenadine Hydrochloride Tablets USP 120 mg] (850X10x1x10s) | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Colombo, Sri Lanka | 30049039 | BOL 1077596". Same B/L 1077596 also covers Fexofen-180 (HS 30049039), Bigomet SR 500 (HS 30049099) and Amlodep 5 (HS 30049072) to Colombo, Sri Lanka. Page header states "Total Shipments 8150", "Trading Partners 28", "Ports 31", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-27"; 5 shipment rows were actually visible in the free view (counter 8150 vs 5 rows seen). Buyer-side lanes visible: UNIQUE TRADE LINK PVT. LTD. (Birgunj, Nepal) and ADK PHARMACEUTICAL COMPANY PVT LTD (Male, Maldives); top ports listed Birgunj 1325, RAXAUL INRXLB 784, RAXAUL 545, SAHAR AIR CARGO INBOM4 181, MALE 119. Source: https://importkey.com/countries/india/aristo-pharmaceuticals-private-limited
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records (27.02.2026, Nhava Sheva -> Colombo, Sri Lanka, HS 30049039/30049099/30049072, B/L 1077596), so the declared HS 300490 is consistent with the actual shipments (subheadings 30049039/99/72) — no HS correction needed. Domestic supply evidence could NOT be verified: web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned connection errors on every attempt, and thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and importgenius.com all returned HTTP 403 / JS challenge. Therefore GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report India/export splits are null — not public in the sources reachable in this run, not invented. Note the ImportKey 'suppliers' block lists ARISTO as a buyer of DANSTAR FERMENT A.G. (excipients), i.e. it also imports raw material, consistent with a manufacturer role rather than a pure trader. Slug variants tried: aristo-pharmaceuticals-pvt-ltd (empty shell), aristo-pharmaceuticals-private-limited (records found), aristo-pharmaceuticals-pvt-ltd-1 and -2 (empty shells).
